qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: KPN owns nationwide fixed fiber and mobile infrastructure in the Netherlands, but regulated wholesale access and three-player competition (VodafoneZiggo, Odido) cap pricing power below inflation, resulting in flat 2022-2025 net income and sub-2% Owner EPS CAGR.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (gate_3b_pricing_and_proof = 'N', REJECT). Regulated wholesale access and intense three-player competition (VodafoneZiggo, Odido) cap real pricing power below inflation, holding Owner EPS CAGR to ~2% over 2022-2025 despite fiber rollout and share buybacks.
qualitative.evidence: KPN operates nationwide Dutch fixed and mobile networks with 12.4% median GAAP ROIC and ~19% tangible ROIC. However, revenue grew just 2.9% p.a. from 2022 to 2025 while cumulative Dutch inflation exceeded 17%, and net income remained flat at €800m. Promotional discounting and regulatory wholesale rate scrutiny eliminate pricing power >= inflation.
